extracted.intended_audience: inventors, patent attorneys, examiners, and historical researchers
extracted.subtask_description: An alphabetical, bibliographic index of United States patents issued in 1877 listing each invention title, patentee, patent number, date, monthly volume, and Official Gazette reference. The page is a continuation of the annual patent index and contains tabulated entries and column headers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alphabetical list of inventions
rubrics_metrics.description: The index is organized as an 'Alphabetical list of inventions' (continued) — entries are arranged by invention or discovery title in alphabetical order.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Header text on the page: 'Alphabetical list of inventions—Continued.' Implies sorting criterion: primary sort key = 'Invention or discovery' (title). This ordering is the organizational principle for the index; entries under successive alphabet letters are grouped and continued across pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Index entry fields / bibliographic columns
rubrics_metrics.description: Each patent entry includes the following columns: 'Invention or discovery.', 'Name of patentee.', 'No.' (patent number), 'Date.', 'Monthly volume.', and 'Official Gazette.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These column headings appear verbatim on the page and define the required bibliographic metadata for each indexed patent. Examples visible on the page show entries filling these fields (e.g., invention title 'Damper, Automatic' / patentee 'M.W. Bailey' / No. '189,865' / Date 'Apr. 24, 1877' / Monthly volume and Official Gazette references). Use these fields when compiling or parsing a patent index for 1877.
